faqs.q: Which solution is used?

faqs.q: Which applications is the Thermal Handheld unit suitable for?
faqs.a: It is suitable for sewer spraying, open-area hot fogging, and frost protection (antifreeze) applications.

faqs.q: How is the unit used for frost protection?
faqs.a: In winter it is run in greenhouses with a suitable antifreeze solution to help prevent plants and the space from freezing.

faqs.q: Which solution is used?
faqs.a: An oil-based solution mixture is used for thermal fogging.

faqs.q: What is the difference versus the Duru K 100?
faqs.a: The Thermal Handheld is carried by hand and offers more flexible use; the K 100 is designed for higher-capacity continuous field work with its wheeled chassis and 15 HP engine.

faqs.q: How long does the fog remain effective?
faqs.a: 20-micron particles stay suspended in the air for a long time, delivering lasting, high-efficiency biocidal effect.

urunler.kisa_aciklama_en: Portable thermal fogger for targeted outdoor and sewer fogging jobs.
